title: cursor4vscode (Unofficial Cursor Agent Panel)
description: Unofficial chat panel that runs a Cursor agent in the open folder. Not affiliated with Cursor or Anysphere. The Cursor SDK is downloaded from npm on first use.

title: Polyscope
description: Read files and logs from local folders, S3 buckets, Kubernetes pods and container logs in one sidebar. Follow logs live, open multi-gigabyte files, and colour tabs by environment. Read-only.

title: hollow tui
description: A dark TUI-style theme: framed windows with labels, gaps between panels, red border on hover and focus-follows-mouse.

title: Sync Worktrees
description: Make registered Git worktrees appear in VS Code Source Control.

title: Dev Companion AI
description: Diagnoses failed terminal commands with AI, lists API endpoints with OpenAPI export, and draws architecture diagrams of the workspace.
